response.query: Which meta-analytic models (multilevel meta-analysis, robust variance estimation, meta-regression) best handle nested effect sizes and heterogenous outcomes?
response.answer: Multilevel meta-analysis and robust variance estimation best handle nested effect sizes and heterogenous outcomes. Meta-regression can also be effective when combined with robust variance estimation.
